items.t: L3Harris to Host Investor Site Visit and Webcast
items.sum: MELBOURNE, Fla., November 27, 2026--L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) will host an investor site visit on Tuesday, Dec. 1, in Rochester, New York.

items.t: Can L3Harris' Australian Defense Award Expand Its All-Domain Reach?
items.sum: LHX secures a nearly $28 million Australian defense contract, unlocking opportunities to expand its capabilities across land, air and maritime domains.

items.t: L3Harris (LHX) Stock Still Looks Cheap Despite Its 46% Run

items.t: Did Record Backlog Just Shift L3Harris Technologies (LHX) Investment Narrative?
items.sum: L3Harris Technologies reported strong Q3 2026 results, with revenue up 7.1%, EPS up 33.3%, $19.3b of quarterly orders, and a record $53.2b backlog that led management to lift full year revenue and EPS guidance. The surge in orders and backlog was concentrated in Space & Mission Systems and Missile Solutions, highlighting where customer demand is most intense inside L3Harris Technologies right now.
